final: ## PR Review Summary: 2 comments drafted, none dropped in validation (draft mode, nothing posted) "UX: show complete URL path if website domain is same as instance domain." I didn't contact GitHub or change the repository. Each finding was checked by a separate validator, and both were confirmed as valid. ### HIGH severity (1) - **The TL0 website restriction is bypassed** (`app/serializers/user_serializer.rb:153`) - **The dead method:** the new `include_website_name` has no `?` at the end. active_model_serializers 0.8.3 only calls methods named `include_?`, so this one never runs. - **The missing guard:** `website_name` was added to the plain `attributes` list. `website` is in `untrusted_attributes`, which hides it from anonymous viewers when the user is TL0. `website_name` gets no such check. - **The result:** the template now checks `model.website_name`. For a TL0 user it renders `{{model.website_name}}`, so anonymous visitors see the website domain that the anti-spam rule was meant to hide. - **The fix:** add `:website_name` to `untrusted_attributes` and delete `include_website_name`. ### LOW severity (1) - **The "same parent domain" check is too loose, and inconsistent** (`app/serializers/user_serializer.rb:144`) - **Shared suffixes match:** the check drops only the first label of each host and compares the rest. So `myforum.herokuapp.com` and `spam.herokuapp.com` count as the same site, as do `a.co.uk` and `b.co.uk`, and the full path gets shown. - **Inconsistent:** a `www.example.com` website on an `example.com` forum shows only the host, while an `example.com` website on `forum.example.com` shows the full path. - **Impact:** display only; the link still points to the real URL. - **The fix:** compare registrable domains using the Public Suffix List, or only show the full path on an exact match or when the website is a parent domain of the forum. ### Dropped in validation (0) `drafts_raw.json` holds the unvalidated drafts. `drafts.json` holds `{"kept": [...], "dropped": [...]}` with each validator's verdict and evidence; both are in `bench/runs/ai-code-review-evaluation_discourse-graphite-6/pr-proof/`.
